SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

Special Branch....................Station. File No....................Date November 20,1941

SUBJECT: Communication dated 6-11-41 from the Netherlands Consulate-General concerning Mrs Vera Levitsky nee Stikova.

Enquiries show that Mrs Vera Ivanovna LEVITSKY nee STIKOVA ( or SHTYKOVA ) was born on February 2,1910 at Handaochedzi Station,Chinese Eastern Railway. According to her own statement, she resided in Harbin from 1924 to 1930 and until 1926 attended a Russian middle school in that city. She first arrived in Shanghai in September,1929 and remained here until the beginning of 1930,after which she returned to Harbin. During that period she resided at 9 Bent Road later removing to 193-A N.Szechuen Road.

It appears that in April,1930 she was married in Harbin to a Russian named Alexander Ivanovich LEVITSKY. Some time towards the end of 1931 the couple came to Shanghai. Soon afterwards the husband joined the Russian Regiment,S.V.C., while Mrs Levitsky is reported to have been employed in some capacity in a restaurant for a period.

In December,1932 the couple came to public notice in connection with A.I. Levitsky's arrest on a charge of "Attempted Murder". As far as can be ascertained the particulars of the case are as follows:-

At 2 a.m. on 5-12-32 A. Levitsky left the barracks of the Russian Regiment without leave,taking with him his service rifle. He proceeded to House 51,Passage 103 Rue Stanislas Chevalier and on being admitted to that house forced open the door of a room,in which his wife and her paramour,a Russian named Neradenko, were living. 报告

特别处....................分局。档案号....................日期 1941年11月20日

主题：荷兰总领事馆1941年11月6日来函，涉及薇拉·列维茨基夫人（娘家姓斯蒂科娃）。

经查，薇拉·伊万诺芙娜·列维茨基（LEVITSKY）夫人，娘家姓斯蒂科娃（STIKOVA）（或什特科娃 SHTYKOVA），于1910年2月2日出生在中东铁路汉道切季站（Handaochedzi Station）。据其自述，她于1924年至1930年间居住在哈尔滨，并在该市的一所俄罗斯中学就读至1926年。她于1929年9月首次抵达上海，停留至1930年初，随后返回哈尔滨。在此期间，她居住在本特路（Bent Road）9号，后迁至北四川路193-A号。

据悉，她于1930年4月在哈尔滨与一名名为亚历山大·伊万诺维奇·列维茨基（Alexander Ivanovich LEVITSKY）的俄罗斯人结婚。1931年底左右，夫妇二人来到上海。不久后，丈夫加入了俄罗斯团（Russian Regiment, S.V.C.），而据报道，列维茨基夫人在一家餐馆受雇工作了一段时间。

1932年12月，这对夫妇因A.I.列维茨基被指控“谋杀未遂”逮捕一事而受到公众关注。据查明的案情细节如下：

1932年12月5日凌晨2时，A.列维茨基未经许可离开俄罗斯团营房，随身携带其服役步枪。他前往士达高拿路（Rue Stanislas Chevalier）103弄51号，进入该房屋后强行撬开一间房门，其妻子及情夫——一名名为涅拉坚科（Neradenko）的俄罗斯人——正居住于此。列维茨基用步枪开了两枪，造成重伤

On 22-12-32 Levitsky was sentenced to 6 years imprisonment. It appears from Russian press reports on the case that about 2 months prior to the occurrence Mrs Levitsky abandoned her husband and went to live with Neradenko, an employee of the French Water Works Company. It also would appear that since that time she and her son Oleg, born on 27-7-33 in Shanghai, have been living separately from her husband. However, there is nothing on record at the Russian Emigrants Committee to show that the couple were divorced. ( Registration forms of Mr. and Mrs Levitsky filed in, respectively, on 2-8-40 and 5-11-41 ).

Mrs Levitsky is not known to have any fixed employment in Shanghai. In her latest registration form at the Russian Emigrants Committee ( 5-11-41 ) she described herself as a manicurist working at clients' homes and gave her address as 1317 Yu Yuen Road.

Municipal Police records contain no reference detrimental to the character of any person named Mrs V.I. Levitsky.

On 10-6-37 during a police raid on a brothel operated under the cover of a "massage establishment" at House 2, Lane 136 Moulmein Road, seven persons were arrested including a Russian female who gave her name as "Viola" STIKOVA and her address as 309 Route Vallon. She was subsequently charged with "Aiding & Abetting in Conducting a Brothel". Four of the prisoners, including "Viola" Stikova, were admitted to $25.00 bail. She failed to appear in Court on the following morning and was fined $10.00 in con-

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告
- 2 -

分局。档案号....................日期....................

主题：
涅拉坚科，并用刺刀刺伤列维茨基夫人。
1932年12月22日，列维茨基被判处六年监禁。从俄文报刊对该案的报道来看，在事发前约两个月，列维茨基夫人抛弃了丈夫，与在法国自来水公司任职的涅拉坚科同居。此外，似乎自那时起，她与1933年7月27日出生于上海的儿子奥列格（Oleg）一直与丈夫分居。然而，在俄罗斯侨民委员会的记录中，并无显示夫妇二人已离婚的文件。（列维茨基先生和夫人的登记表分别归档于1940年8月2日和1941年11月5日）。

在上海，未发现列维茨基夫人有固定职业。在她于1941年11月5日填写的俄罗斯侨民委员会最新登记表中，她自称是一名上门为顾客服务的美甲师，住址为愚园路1317号。

工部局警务处档案中，没有任何对名为V.I.列维茨基夫人的品行不利的记录。

1937年6月10日，警方突袭了位于莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）136弄2号、以“按摩院”为幌子经营的妓院，逮捕了七人，其中包括一名自称名为“维奥拉”（Viola）斯蒂科娃、住址为华伦路（Route Vallon）309号的俄罗斯女子。她随后被指控“协助及教唆经营妓院”。包括“维奥拉”斯蒂科娃在内的四名囚犯获准以25.00美元保释。次日早晨她未出庭应讯，并因此项指控被罚款10.00美元，但

SUBJECT:
nection with the above charge. Neither her finger-prints
nor photograph were taken by the police.
Having in view the possibility of "Viola" Sti-
va being identical with Mrs V.I. Levitsky nee Stikova,
efforts have been made to obtain, by discreet enquiries
and with the aid of Mrs Levitsky's most recent photograph
available, conclusive proof to this effect, but without
success. However, the following information obtained
during the course of enquiries seems to be suggestive of
such a possibility:-
(1) When registering at the Russian Emigrants
Committee on 17-8-37, i. e. shortly after the police raid
in question, Mrs Levitsky gave her address as 309 Route
Vallon.
(2) In her registration form at the R.E.Committee
dated 5-11-41 she mentioned as a reference a certain
Mrs.Z. Voronoff residing at 404 Avenue Joffre, Apt.1.
Enquiries show that the full name of the person in ques-
tion is Mrs Zoya Semenovna Voronoff nee Kisseleff, age
about 45, and that there are reasons to believe that she
was also connected in some capacity with the "massage es-
tablishment" at 136/2 Moulmein Road.
G. Pinker
D. I.
A. G. ( Special Branch ).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
- 3 -
分局。档案号....................日期....................
主题：
警方未采集其指纹或照片。
鉴于“维奥拉”斯蒂科娃可能与V.I.列维茨基夫人（娘家姓斯蒂科娃）为同一人的可能性，警方曾试图通过谨慎查询，并借助现有的列维茨基夫人最近照片，获取确凿证据，但未获成功。然而，在调查过程中获得的以下信息似乎暗示了这种可能性：
(1) 列维茨基夫人在1937年8月17日向俄罗斯侨民委员会登记时，即在上述警方突袭行动后不久，提供的住址为华伦路309号。
(2) 在她1941年11月5日填写的俄罗斯侨民委员会登记表中，她提到一位居住在霞飞路404号1室的Z.沃罗诺夫（Voronoff）夫人为证明人。调查显示，该人的全名为佐娅·谢苗诺芙娜·沃罗诺夫（Zoya Semenovna Voronoff）夫人，娘家姓基谢廖夫（Kisseleff），年龄约45岁，且有理由相信她也以某种身份与莫尔缅路136/2号的“按摩院”有关联。
G. Pinker
D. I.
A. G. （特别处）。

Consulaat-Generaal der Nederlanden voor Midden-China
7/×¹

Tel. Ad.: "Hollandia"
Telefoon: 80135/6
No. 4977-639.

Shanghai, 6th November 1941.
9 Quai de France

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mrs. Vera LEVITSKAYA
née Stikova has applied to this Consulate General for a visé
for admission into Netherlands India.

Mrs. Levitskaya has stated to me that she was born at
Nicolsk, Russia on September 30, 1913.

From 1924 till 1930 she was residing in Harbin and since
that time in Shanghai.

In 1933 she obtained a divorce from her husband Alexander
Levitsky, out of which marriage on July 27, 1933 a son Aleg
was born.

She is residing at present at 1317 Yu Yuen Road and is
registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee, Moumein Road.

She has the intention of going to Java accompanied by her
son to visit Mr. C. van den Eyk, a Netherlander employed with
the Netherlands Harbour Works at Bandoeng, who stayed in
Shanghai a few years ago, and who has asked her to proceed to
Bandoeng.

（批：S.J. / 6/L / 6-11. Hl.）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / NOV 6 1941 / SPECIAL BRANCH）

From correspondence shown it appears that Mr. van den Eyk
intends to marry the lady in question.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me
know whether anything is known against this person from a
political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

The Deputy Commissioner of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：D.I. Piekfijer / please bdl）

Consul-General.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
7/×¹

电报挂号：“Hollandia”
电话：80135/6
第4977-639号。

上海，1941年11月6日。
法兰西外滩9号

先生：

谨此通知阁下，薇拉·列维茨卡娅（LEVITSKAYA）夫人（娘家姓斯蒂科娃）已向本总领事馆申请签证，以便进入荷属东印度。

列维茨卡娅夫人向本人陈述，她于1913年9月30日出生在俄罗斯尼科尔斯克（Nicolsk）。

1924年至1930年期间，她居住在哈尔滨，此后一直居住在上海。

1933年，她与丈夫亚历山大·列维茨基离婚，婚姻期间于1933年7月27日生下一子阿列格（Aleg）。

她目前居住在愚园路1317号，并在莫尔缅路的俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。

她打算携子前往爪哇，拜访在万隆荷兰港务局工作的荷兰人C.范登艾克（C. van den Eyk）先生。范登艾克先生几年前曾在上海逗留，并邀请她前往万隆。

（批注：S.J. / 6/L / 11月6日. Hl.）

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1941年11月6日 / 特别处）

从出示的信件来看，范登艾克先生有意与该女士结婚。

如蒙告知从政治或道德角度是否知晓此人有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别处副总监
上海。

（批注：D.I. Piekfijer / 请归档）

总领事。
